## Kbd.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `keys` :: The keys to draw, in order. `mod` is drawn as ⌘ on Apple platforms and as Ctrl elsewhere.
- `separator` :: The text drawn between two keys.
- `size` :: The key cap height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the cap height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the separator drawn between two caps; muted by default so the keys stay the heavier element.
- `children` :: The key label, used when `keys` is not given.
